Boogie SuperStar.name: Boogie Superstar
Boogie SuperStar.summary: Boogie SuperStar, the sequel to Boogie, is a dancing and karaoke game. It can be played with either the included microphone for singing or with the wii remote for dancing. Players need to match the rhythm and pitch to sing, or follow a specific dance routine by performing sequences of dance moves and combos to dance. The objective of the game is to work your way to stardom by competing in the star show where you can earn tokens that can be redeemed for reward packages. These contain new songs, dance moves, combos, dance routines, dressing room items as well as style skill progression.

De Blob.name: de Blob
De Blob.summary: de Blob is a 3D platformer where players maneuver their hero, de Blob. Equal parts amorphous blob of paint, struggling artist, revolutionary and juvenile delinquent, de Blob's goal is to replace the drab, lifeless gray coloring that the I.N.K.T. Corporation has imposed on Chroma City and its inhabitants, the Raydians, with a range of vibrant life-giving colors, all the while avoiding and battling the gray-clad forces of the Inkies.

Mahjong Fight Club Wii - Wi-Fi Taiou.name: Mahjong Fight Club Wii: Wi-Fi Taiou
Mahjong Fight Club Wii - Wi-Fi Taiou.summary:
Mahjong Kakutou Club Wii: Wi-Fi Taiou, the latest version of the “Mahjong Fighting Club” series is finally available on Wii! Support Nintendo Wi-Fi connection and enjoy online matches with Wii users nationwide for free! Japan Professional Mahjong Federation official recognition a total of 52 professional sparrow CPUs play! Full of other functions!

If you are connected to the network, you can play “National Battles” where you compete with players from all over the country for free! The deep game system, rich ranking function, and functions such as “Meetings” full of benefits are intertwined organically, creating a “weight of one stroke”! The real attraction of “Mahjong Fighting Club” is national competition!

Supports DS download play! If there is one this work, you can enjoy playing with Wii (1 person) and Nintendo DS (up to 3 people). The nationwide battle that many rivals await is even more heated!

My Horse Club - On the Trail of the Myst.name: My Horse Club: On the Trail of the Mysterious Appaloosa
My Horse Club - On the Trail of the Myst.summary: A Game For Horse Lovers With A Sense Of Adventure. Discover the secret of the mysterious Appaloosa while horseback riding, western style in gorgeous surroundings.

Yukinko Daisenpuu - Sayuki to Koyuki no.name: Heavenly Guardian
Yukinko Daisenpuu - Sayuki to Koyuki no.summary: The Snow Fairy Sayuki is on a quest to save her beloved from the evil curse of the demons plaguing her land. In order to save her companions life, she must travel through the far reaches of ancient Japan and battle mythological creatures in her pursuit of a secret remedy. Heavenly Guardian embodies the fast paced fun and adventure of the classic arcade shooter while utilizing the powers of the Sony Playstation 2 to add new thrills to the genre. Journey through various environments and fight through a variety of mythological creatures! Fight the journey solo, or gain the aid of your companions in cooperative two-player action. Search for power-ups and special items to vanquish the evil gods and save your love from death.
